title: Senior Legal Counsel

  • Strong drafting and research skills and experience working with and managing external counsel

  • Work at the heart of the Grove ecosystem on high-impact, first-of-their-kind transactions alongside a leading crypto-native financial advisory team

  • Exposure across an exceptional breadth of matters, from structured credit transactions and tokenized products to regulatory strategy and corporate work

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Innovate with Tether

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices, it gives users greater control over their data and how they use artificial intelligence. Our focus is on local, on-device, and privacy-preserving AI, with opportunities to connect these experiences across Tether’s peer-to-peer ecosystem.

We’re looking for a Product Manager with a strong interest in AI and a practical understanding of how to turn emerging capabilities into useful products.

You will work closely with the Product Lead to help advance the QV.AC vision: identifying valuable use cases, defining AI features, exploring product concepts, and working with engineering and design to bring them to users. You’ll contribute to product direction and take responsibility for moving assigned features from discovery through delivery and iteration.

This role suits someone who knows how to leverage AI to the maximum and enjoys experimenting with new AI technologies, understands its possibilities and limitations, and cares about making complex technology easy to use.

Responsibilities

  • Help shape AI features: Work with the Product Lead to translate the QV.AC vision into concrete use cases, feature proposals, and product requirements. Bring ideas grounded in user needs, research, and hands-on experimentation.

  • Understand users and their problems: Gather feedback, conduct research, and explore how people use AI in their everyday workflows. Identify where AI can solve a meaningful problem and where a simpler solution may work better.

  • Turn ideas into clear specifications: Write product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and user flows that help engineering and design understand the intended experience, constraints, and measures of success.

  • Prototype and explore: Create wireframes, mockups, and working prototypes to test ideas and communicate product behavior. Use AI-assisted tools to explore concepts quickly and refine them with the team.

  • Collaborate on technical trade-offs: Work with engineers to understand what is feasible across devices and models. Help assess the impact of response quality, latency, memory usage, battery consumption, and privacy on the user experience.

  • Support prioritization and planning: Help the Product Lead evaluate opportunities, clarify scope, identify dependencies, and maintain a focused backlog aligned with product priorities.

  • Drive feature delivery: Follow assigned features through development, resolve product questions, review the experience, and coordinate feedback and release readiness with relevant teams.

  • Stay close to AI developments: Explore new AI products, models, tools, and interaction patterns, and explain their practical relevance to QV.AC. Share clear recommendations about what is worth testing or adopting and why.


Mandatory:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally working on AI software products with technical engineering teams.

  • Practical experience building, shipping, or prototyping AI-powered features, with the ability to explain your contribution and what you learned.

  • A working understanding of AI concepts such as inference, harnesses, model capabilities and limitations, context, and evaluation, alongside an interest in local and on-device AI.

  • The ability to translate an ambiguous idea into a clear user problem, proposed solution, and actionable requirements.

  • Strong product judgment, with attention to usability, scope, and measurable user value.

  • Confidence creating prototypes using design or coding tools

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and explain them to non-technical colleagues.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach: comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions early, and incorporating feedback.

  • Familiarity with product analytics, user research, and iterative software development.

Preferred:

  • Experience with local AI, on-device inference, or open-source models.

  • Experience building AI assistants, conversational interfaces, or multimodal features.

  • Familiarity with desktop or mobile product development.

  • An understanding of peer-to-peer technologies and decentralized applications.

  • Experience evaluating AI output quality and designing user experiences that account for uncertainty and errors.

  • Experience working in a distributed team.

The Role

The Director of Accounting Advisory is the senior people leader for BKA's Service Delivery Team, directly managing the Division Managers, Project Team, and ERP Specialist. Success is measured by how well this leader coaches, develops, and holds Division Managers accountable to clear performance standards, and by the consolidated results those divisions deliver.

The Director is expected to lead through their managers, not around them. On the client operations side, the Director makes sure capacity, staffing, and project work stay aligned so client commitments are met on time and at a high standard. Where You'll Drive Impact

People Leadership

  • Serve as an escalation point for client relationships, and guide Division Managers through complex or at-risk engagements.

  • Drive the shift from report delivery to proactive advisory, and help managers spot cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Product
description:
About Jito


Jito builds the market layer of Solana: the execution, capital, and incentive infrastructure behind the network's onchain economy. That includes the validator client running the majority of Solana stake, BAM (a new framework for verifiable ordering, pre-execution privacy, and programmable blockspace), JitoSOL (the leading liquid staking token on Solana), and JTX (trading built directly on our own market infrastructure).

We are a lean, high-density team. Everyone here owns real surface area, works in the open, and ships at pace. The engineers on this team are the people market makers call when milliseconds matter.

About Jito

Jito builds the Market Layer of Solana: the execution systems, capital markets, and incentive mechanisms that power real markets on-chain.

Our products process billions in daily transaction value. The Jito-Solana validator client runs on the vast majority of Solana's active stake. BAM is redefining how blocks get built. JitoSOL is the leading liquid staking token on the network. We are not building at the margins. We are building core infrastructure that Solana's economy runs on.

Now we're moving up the stack, bringing that same infrastructure advantage to products that traders and users interact with directly.

We're a team of around 50 people with product-market fit across multiple product lines and years of runway. We take hard problems seriously and move fast on them. Nothing is out of reach.

About the Role

We've gone from one main product line to four, and the security work on those products has outgrown the one person doing it. This role owns product and protocol security: the surface where our code meets real money.

You'll report to the Head of Security and work alongside an Enterprise Security Engineer who owns internal infrastructure, identity and detection. The split is deliberate. They secure how we work; you secure what we ship.

This is an engineering role. Most of the backlog is code, not policy.

What You'll Own

  • Product and protocol security reviews: threat modeling, secure design review, whitebox code review, and getting in early enough to change designs rather than document them

  • Deployment hardening across our product lines, including the jito-solana deploy process

  • Ongoing internal audits of our own products rather than waiting for an external engagement to surface issues

  • Onchain monitoring: standing up tooling like Hypernative or Blockaid and building the detections that catch probing before an attack is underway

  • Bug bounty operations as we bring more of the program in-house: triage, severity assessment, remediation tracking, and escalation

  • Auditor findings driven through to closure: reviewed, prioritized, assigned, tracked

  • AI-assisted security testing and continuous scanning, plus the security surface that comes with agents and AI tooling operating inside a codebase

  • High-impact key and asset risks: key hygiene, hot wallet and engineering keys, multisigs, security councils

What We're Looking For

  • A software engineering background is essential. You've built production systems, and that foundation shapes how you approach security.

  • You've since moved into product security and are fluent across the lifecycle: threat modeling, secure design review, whitebox code review, and vulnerability testing

  • 5+ years of professional experience, with a meaningful portion in software engineering before moving into security

  • Proficiency in at least one systems or backend language. Rust preferred; Go, C++, or Python also work. You will read production codebases and build tooling as routine parts of this job.

  • Demonstrated experience in product or application security, not solely infrastructure or compliance work

  • A track record of building security tooling or automation from scratch

  • Experience running or contributing to a bug bounty program, or a clear view of how you'd run one

  • Genuine interest in AI security, including adversarial testing of agent controls

  • Strong written communication. Findings nobody can act on are findings that don't get fixed.

  • Comfortable with high ownership and working autonomously on a small team

  • Experience in web3, crypto, or DeFi

Nice to Have

  • Smart contract or onchain security experience, particularly on Solana or another SVM chain

  • Experience with onchain monitoring tooling such as Hypernative or Blockaid

  • Familiarity with validator or consensus infrastructure

  • Experience with multisig schemes: signing policy design, quorum configuration, or key management in production

  • Familiarity with hardware security modules: integration, key lifecycle, or operational use

  • Exposure to trusted execution environments: attestation, confidential compute, or secure enclave design

  • Experience with fuzzing, formal verification, or property-based testing of financial logic

Why This Role Exists

Security at Jito has been one person covering four product lines, an expanding AI surface, and a validator client running most of Solana's stake. That person has been spending their time on the most likely risks, which means the highest-impact ones get less attention than they deserve.

We're hiring two engineers so that ownership is distributed rather than bottlenecked, and so losing one person doesn't cost the whole function. The goal is not more approval steps. It is safer defaults, earlier input, and engineering that moves faster because security is in the room rather than at the gate.

How we work


Remote-first, writing-heavy, and transparent by default: most decisions happen in public Slack channels, and everyone's voice carries. We value ownership, humility, curiosity, and getting it done over getting it perfect. Small egos, high standards.


What we offer


Competitive compensation including salary and token incentives, the tools you need to do your best work, and a seat at the center of Solana's market infrastructure alongside some of the strongest engineers in the ecosystem.
